# Bundled frontend libraries

| File | Project | License |
|------|---------|---------|
| `toastui-calendar.min.js`, `toastui-calendar.min.css` | [Toast UI Calendar 2.1.3](https://github.com/nhn/tui.calendar) | MIT |
| `codemirror.js`, `codemirror.css`, `python.js`, `material-darker.css` | [CodeMirror 5.65.16](https://github.com/codemirror/codemirror5) | MIT |

Both licenses permit redistribution in source and binary form provided the
copyright notice and permission notice are retained. The files are unmodified
distribution builds; upstream repositories contain the full license texts.

The native Android shell (`android/`) is original dir3 code. Its alarm
behaviour is *inspired by* [BlackyHawky/Clock](https://github.com/BlackyHawky/Clock)
(GPL-3.0), but no source code was copied from that project.
